title: Seal drifted prior stack identity in dev release capture

reproduction.incident_description: Deployment run 35193009030 successfully forwarded baseline_source (accepted_frontend_pair_manifest+live_bff_drift_recovery) and observed_live_bff_sha (dc15751a9b20f8bc0931529d68af8898e691c898) to the remote driver, which captured the live services whose oci_revision was dc15751a9. On the runner, capture_dev_artifact_baseline.py stage seal-result failed at line 283 with 'capture image revision differs from prior' because DRIFT_FIELDS were only forwarded in remote_script() at line 214 and never consulted during wrapper seal validation at lines 262 to 296, which only accepted previous_backend_sha (ae41705b4). Additionally, the driver previously labelled bundle source_sha with previous_backend_sha instead of the observed live sha.

root_cause.wrapper_seal_omitted_drift_validation: capture_dev_artifact_baseline.py:seal_result() only checked bundle source_sha and service oci_revisions against identity['previous_backend_sha'] without consulting baseline_source or observed_live_bff_sha.
root_cause.driver_bundle_source_sha_labelling: dev_release_artifact_driver.py labelled the captured image bundle source_sha with previous_backend_sha rather than the observed live SHA under drift recovery.

fix_description.dev_release_artifact_driver_py: Unified drift identity model: when baseline_source ends with +live_bff_drift_recovery, capture, seal-candidate, verify, and restore use expected_source_sha equal to drift_sha, making the captured image bundle identity the observed live sha for source_sha and oci_revision while preserving previous_backend_sha and previous_frontend_sha for the compose file, rollback authority, and frontend pair checks.
fix_description.capture_dev_artifact_baseline_py: Added _drift_recovery_source(baseline_source, observed_live_bff_sha) helper and plumbed drift inputs into seal_result() and main(). When drift recovery is active, validates bundle source_sha and service oci_revisions against observed_live_bff_sha; records both the accepted pair (previous_backend_sha, previous_frontend_sha) and observed_live_bff_sha in outputs and manifest; and fails closed on invalid sha format or revision mismatches.
fix_description.test_coverage: Added reproduction test and comprehensive drift seal test suite in test_capture_dev_artifact_baseline.py covering success, absence of drift inputs, invalid 40-hex SHA format, revision mismatch, and real wrapper seal path with fake transport; updated test_dev_release_artifact_driver.py to assert bundle source_sha is drift_sha and verify capture/seal/verify/restore; added test_dev_release_artifacts.py test verifying primitive capture/validate/restore under drift recovery source identity.

invariants_enforced.rollback_authority_preserved: The accepted pair (previous_backend_sha, previous_frontend_sha) and its compose file remain the sole rollback authority; the frontend manifest strictly compares against the accepted pair.
invariants_enforced.drift_identity_model: Under drift recovery, the captured prior image bundle identity is the observed live sha for source_sha and oci_revision.
invariants_enforced.fail_closed_security: Without drift inputs, drifted manifests fail existing checks; non-40-hex observed sha or revision mismatch strictly fails closed.
invariants_enforced.isolation: Pure source and isolated test scope only; no hosted deployments, redeploys, or capital changes performed.
